name: MLSC 4302
title: Clinical Chemistry Laboratory
description: Application of the theory and techniques learned in MLSC 4301 to the clinical laboratory setting. Understanding work flow, teamwork, evaluation of normal and abnormal results; instrumentation and quality assurance or the general laboratory environment.
requirement_description: A grade of "C" or better in MLSC 4301. Open only to Medical Laboratory Sciences majors and Medical Laboratory Sciences certificate students; others with consent of Medical Laboratory Sciences Program Director.
